description: This file contains unit tests for the TrustedCertificateAuthority class, verifying its ability to correctly decode and validate certificate data from JSON objects, including handling X.509 certificates and public key information.

classes.name: TrustedCertificateAuthorityTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the decoding and validation of trusted certificate authorities in various formats.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a self-signed certificate for testing before all tests run.

methods.name: testDecodeTrustedCAUsingPublicKey
methods.description: Tests decoding a trusted CA from a JSON object containing public key info.

methods.name: testDecodeTrustedCAUsingCert
methods.description: Tests decoding a trusted CA from a JSON object containing a certificate.

methods.name: testDecodeTrustedCAUsingCertAndPublicKey
methods.description: Tests decoding a trusted CA when both certificate and public key info are provided, ensuring subject DN and key algorithm are derived from the certificate.

methods.name: assertAuthority
methods.description: Helper method to validate properties of the TrustedCertificateAuthority object against the expected certificate.
